top_signals.title: Stocks Rise Ahead of PPI; Microsoft Outage; Nvidia Fallout
top_signals.summary: US equity futures rise as investors await the latest inflation data to cap a dramatic week. Microsoft sees signs of early stabilization from a global service outage affecting Outlook, Teams, and Copilot. US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick comes under scrutiny amid Nvidia’s leadership crisis. Michael Purves of Tallbacken Capital joins “Bloomberg Brief” to discuss the latest bond rout and look ahead to the PPI data. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Nvidia's Next CEO Won't Have Same Drive as Huang, warns Munster
top_signals.summary: The fall of Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang has removed the industry’s most prominent opponent of US chip controls, setting up a showdown over potential new curbs that could accelerate China’s drive for semiconductor self-sufficiency. Huang’s exit on Thursday smooths the way for lawmakers and the US Commerce Department to choke off China’s access to computing power through smuggling and other workarounds. Those measures, if enacted, risk provoking Beijing to retaliate and shattering a fragile truce reached by Donald Trump and Xi Jinping over their cordial summits. For more, Bloomberg's Nathan Hager speaks with Gene Munster, Deepwater Asset Management managing partner and Dan Ives,  Yorkville Ives founder and managing partner (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Wholesale Inflation Climbs to Fastest Pace Since 2022
top_signals.summary: US wholesale inflation remained elevated in October, as the producer price index rose 6.5% from a year earlier. The PPI advanced 0.3% from a month earlier, according to Bureau of Labor Statistics data out Friday. Michael McKee reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.summary: Gold smuggling from Africa to the United Arab Emirates showed little sign of slowing after the Gulf state introduced tougher sourcing rules, according to a new report by SwissAid.
